text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Armed Islamist "terrorists" attacked defenceless civilians at Haouch Boughlef-Khemisti village killing 93 people, many of them women.
- A "terrorist group" massacred 93 citizens farm community, south of Algiers. The killing was the worst since the beginning of massacres in October.
- The "terrorists" planted mines around farm village to delay emergency aid to the victims.
- "Terrorists" savagely masscre 93 people in Bougara region, south of Algiers. Ahead of every politique rendezvous involving the future of our people, the "terrorists" target innocent civilians.
